correctness.rationale: From the source Table 1, all 3276 three-by-three determinants are computed exactly in \(\mathbb Z[\alpha]\) with \(\alpha^2+\alpha+2=0\), yielding nonzero norms supported on primes 2,3,7,11. This algebraically excludes other new concurrences; every line has a unit coefficient. Exact projective cross-product grouping gives generic profile (252 double,21 quadruple) and geometric profiles p3 (63 quadruple), p7 (8 sevenfold,21 quadruple,28 triple), p11 at both primes (21 quadruple,84 triple). Distinct dyadic factors give precisely the two stated nonreduced special fibers. Over F7 the reduced 28 equations equal all secants of Q=X^2+Y^2+Z^2=0. Every p11 line has nine triple and three quadruple F11-points. Arithmetic computations are finite exhaustive certificates, while universal exclusion is a norm argument, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The 28 Klein bitangents form a canonical symmetric line arrangement; their good and bad reduction arithmetic and precise modular incidence are natural invariants of the integral realization. The all-prime list has genuine geometric content: the p7 reduction realizes the complete 28-secant structure of a smooth eight-point conic, p11 unexpectedly creates 84 triple points although 11 does not divide 168, and the two primes over 2 exhibit different nonreduced line multiplicities. A complete exact classification of all primes and all components is worth preserving, beyond a routine specialization or an isolated finite computation.
